SPCX IPO'd 10 days ago at $135 and quickly ran higher to as much as $225 in subsequent sessions. It's been straight down since, though, with even today's news of a multi-billion dollar deal to provide computing resources to AI startup Reflection AI failing to stop the decline. The Nasdaq closed near its session low, down 1.3%, while the S&P 500 lost just 0.35% and the DJIA actually gained 0.3%.
